masterKey.source: External random key; file/key lifecycle and CLI implemented separately.

frame.prefix: 4-byte unsigned big-endian ciphertext length followed by 1-byte kind
frame.nonce: 4 zero bytes followed by 8-byte big-endian implicit sequence, beginning at0
frame.aad: 40-byte header || 8-byte big-endian implicit sequence || 5-byte frame prefix

callerContract: Thread confined; failed states cannot be reused.
Only authenticated chunks are returned, but a chunk prefix does not establish bundle completeness.
Restore must stage and publish only after authenticated final marker and exactEOF.
Stream layer does not define file metadata, paths, backup membership or revision rollback policy.
